---
title: Pecorino with Parsley
id: MAR-0059
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 15
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 8 slices of Pecorino Romano
- 20 g of parsley
- 2 garlic cloves
- 2 tablespoons of extra virgin olive oil
- to taste black pepper
## Method
1. Wash the parsley, dry it and remove the stems.
2. Peel the garlic and chop it with the parsley.
3. Grease 4 terracotta molds with the oil, arrange the Pecorino Romano slices and sprinkle each slice with the parsley mixture.
4. Place under the oven grill until the cheese begins to melt.
5. Finish with a grind of black pepper and serve.
